cases.name: Ruthene Tukes
cases.about: She was a pastor. She was described as the backbone of her family. "I loved her so much. She was my sweetest, innocent & goodest grandmother I could ever have," said her grandson. Her daughter said, "If you were hungry, she fed you. If you needed somewhere to stay, she would open up her doors no matter what time of day.
